findings.summary: The proposed gate does not prove all of the contract it calls exhaustive, including the required configured-shell result for replaced state/v1 and missing-shell cases.
findings.evidence: docs/briefs/B20261126-1003-b41-i161-doctor-gate-shell-replaced-plan.loop-brief.md:96-116 declares every table row, while :111-116 requires only the planted pass for a complete state/v2 plan and the same-brief problem. The worked example at :148-156 additionally pins --json and the configured-shell warning when neither shell is on PATH; none of those cases is required by the stated gate. internal/cli/doctor.go:535-589 shows the replacement decision and shell result are separate today, so a task could pass the narrow gate while still mishandling one of those required paths.
findings.fix: Make the task's gate run the complete table on Windows and assert the literal gate-shell result/message for text and --json: no plan, complete state/v2 for bare doctor and another/same/no brief, complete state/v1, and non-complete plans. Include the missing configured shell's mixed-team problem and non-mixed warning, with controlled PATH, plus the planted base failure.

findings.summary: The shape has no final task that runs every gate and the worked example line by line.
findings.evidence: docs/briefs/B20261126-1003-b41-i161-doctor-gate-shell-replaced-plan.loop-brief.md:191-199 permits only one implementation task and an optional guide sentence; the guide task, when present, is gated only on text presence. The create-brief standard at .vloop/tmp/plugin/0.15.0-rc.4/skills/create-brief/guidelines.md:76-78 requires the last task to run every gate and the worked example line by line.
findings.fix: Revise the task range and make the last task an integration/close gate that runs all earlier gates and every worked-example line, or explicitly fold that complete aggregate gate into the single final task. Keep the guide assertion as part of that final proof.

decisions: Use one replacement decision for both the plan and gate-shell rows; sound and consistent with the existing B31 plan-row rule.
When a plan is replaced, judge the configured shell exactly as when no plan exists; sound and required by P-5's limit to plans that still have gates.
Keep 'on PATH' as exec.LookPath and control PATH in the test; sound and portable when the gate supplies both executables.
Limit documentation to one sentence in docs/guide/concepts.md; sound for this small behavior change.
checked: facts, consistency, repository rules, runnability, operator-visible decisions; structural brief check
